name: Hindsight Obsidian Sync
description: Syncs an Obsidian vault into a Hindsight bank without the Obsidian app, using the hindsight-obsidian-sync CLI from this app's own folder.

faq.question: The app stops immediately after start
faq.answer: Set the vault folder and the API token, then start again. The Output tab shows the CLI message for a missing vault, a rejected token or an unreachable API.

faq.question: Where is the sync index stored
faq.answer: Outside the vault, under your home folder in ~/.hindsight/obsidian/, so Obsidian Sync never copies it. Delete that file to force a full reingest.

faq.question: Can it run next to the Obsidian plugin
faq.answer: Yes, but keep the two configurations identical (folders, bank, vault name, document-id prefix, timestamp source). Each frontend prunes only what its own index tracks.

settings.label: Vault folder
settings.help: Folder of the Obsidian vault to sync. Required.

settings.label: Hindsight API URL
settings.help: Address of the Hindsight API. No trailing slash.

settings.label: API token
settings.help: Sent as HINDSIGHT_API_TOKEN, not on the command line. Stored in this app's settings.json file.

settings.label: Fact date source
settings.help: created dates facts by the note creation time, updated by the last edit. Use updated for notes you keep editing.
